title: South Port Marine

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: South Port Marine operates at 14 Ocean Street in South Portland, with new and pre-owned boats for sale. Not just a sales lot. The yard runs a certified service shop, 170 wet slips, indoor heated storage, a parts counter, and boat rentals, all from one waterfront property. Located at 14 Ocean Street on the South Portland waterfront, our full-service boatyard and marina serves boaters across Casco Bay and the southern Maine coast. In-season Sun - Wed: 8 AM - 6 PM Thu - Sat: 8 AM - 8 PM Off-season Mon - Fri: 9 AM - 5 PM Winter weekends Reduced hours Offshore center consoles and dual consoles from bay boats up to 29-foot deep-V
